name: Azato Kawaii Watashi ga Yuushou
original_name: あざとかわいいワタシが優勝
overview: Kotone Matsushima has always relied on her “cunning cuteness” to get her way — until she meets Nazuna Sahara, a rival just as charming and clever. What begins as a clash for attention quickly escalates into a fierce battle of wit, charm, and pride between the two women.
